Tajweed — design 3 (round 3), “the first era” — the Prophet ﷺ, the Companions, the Rightly Guided Caliphs

A new design for the same application. Twenty-eight directions, each in day and night: twenty-seven for ordinary sight — the first sheets of the Quran, Hira, the Cave, Taybah, Uhud, “look at the camels”, dawn, the forenoon, rain, the two gardens, the fig and the olive, al-Kawthar, the sun and the moon, the scattering winds, the crop, the pasture, the good tree, the birds, the shade, the ships, al-Asr, the extended shade, the rivers, the lofty dwellings, fruit hanging near, the tents, light — and the last, Mountains, for low vision and colour blindness. Each direction draws its own landscape; the prayer times stand on the path of the sun. Every reason, with its ayah or hadith: design-3-meanings.md. Designs 1 and 2 are round 1 and round 2. Prayer times, reading position and reciter are sample data; every Quran word is copied from the verified files.

9 · The twenty-eight directions — tap one to see it everywhere

Each direction takes its colours from the Quran or from a place and an object of the first era, and draws its own landscape. The full reasons, with what was avoided and why: design-3-meanings.md.

10 · The logo and the icons — why each one

Generic icons (search, bookmark, arrows) stay generic so they are understood at once. The section icons each come from something of the first era.
